crossRefs.note: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

translations.web: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
translations.bsb: When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
translations.kjv: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
translations.asv: Thou givest unto them, they gather; Thou openest thy hand, they are satisfied with good.
